problem_type: Mixed-integer linear optimization: Steiner tree problem with an energy yield quota, node weights, and a weighted cost/scenic objective

decisions.business: Whether the node is in the final tree; a candidate turbine site is 1 if and only if a turbine is built there, a Steiner node is 1 when used for routing, and all substations must be 1.
decisions.shape: One-dimensional 0/1 integer array of length n; the i-th entry corresponds to node i.
decisions.completeness: Exactly n binary values must be provided with no node omitted; all substation entries must be 1, the total annual energy yield of the selected candidate turbines must reach the quota, and the nodes set to 1 must be fully consistent with the tree described by edge_selected.

decisions.business: Whether each feasible cable edge is laid and included in the final tree.
decisions.shape: One-dimensional 0/1 integer array of length m; the e-th entry corresponds to edges[e].
decisions.completeness: Exactly m binary values must be provided with no edge omitted; both endpoints of every edge set to 1 must be 1 in node_selected, and all edges set to 1 must form, over all selected nodes, a single connected acyclic tree containing all substations, i.e., the number of selected edges equals the number of selected nodes minus one.
